Belgium Battles Record Wildfire; EU Allies Offer Aid

Belgium is experiencing its largest-ever wildfire, which has scorched approximately 2,000 to 3,000 hectares in the High Fens National Park. The blaze has forced hundreds of residents to evacuate from two villages near the German border. EU allies are providing assistance to combat the fire. The wildfire has spread rapidly, doubling in size in two days and creeping towards Germany. The affected area is a popular nature reserve known for its peatlands and pine forests.
